title: Overconfidence, Under-Reaction, and Warren Buffett’s Investments
summary:
RGA Investment Advisors runs a long-term, low turnover, growth at a reasonable price investment strategy seeking out global opportunities. The paper is available at https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1635061

 Enjoy the conversation! The primary purpose of this podcast is to educate and inform.
